mapper.select: SELECT s.*, u.username as author_name FROM sub_issues s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.author_id = u.id WHERE s.parent_issue_id = #{parentIssueId} ORDER BY s.created_at ASC
SELECT s.*, u.username as author_name FROM sub_issues s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.author_id = u.id WHERE s.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sub_issues (parent_issue_id, title, content, image_url, is_resolved, author_id) VALUES (#{parentIssueId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, #{isResolved}, #{authorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE sub_issues SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, is_resolved = #{isResolved}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sub_issues SET is_resolved = NOT is_resolved, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
